name: carsxe
description: Look up CarsXE vehicle data: specifications, plate and VIN decode, history, images, recalls, market value, and OBD-II codes.

interface.longDescription:
CarsXE looks up vehicle data for people comparing, servicing, or researching a car. It returns specifications, license-plate and international VIN decodes, market-value estimates, history, images, safety recalls, year/make/model details, OBD-II definitions, and lien or theft records.

CarsXE does not buy or sell vehicles, arrange financing, book service, or give driving directions. Sign in with a CarsXE account to run a lookup.
defaultPrompt: What are the full specifications for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956?
Are there any recalls for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956?
Estimate the market value of VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956 with 85000 miles.

positive.description: Inspect specifications for a vehicle identified by VIN.
positive.prompt: What are the full specifications for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available identification, engine, trim, dimensions, equipment, and other specification details for the VIN.

positive.description: Estimate a used vehicle's value with condition adjustments.
positive.prompt: Estimate the market value of VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956 in California with 85000 miles in clean condition.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the available market-value estimate and relevant valuation details for the supplied vehicle inputs.

positive.description: Review vehicle history before a purchase decision.
positive.prompt: Get the vehicle history report for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available history information for the VIN and clearly reports when no matching report is available.

positive.description: Check a VIN for safety recalls.
positive.prompt: Are there any recalls for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available recall records and their relevant safety details for the VIN.

positive.description: Fetch specs as data, then render a vehicle card.
positive.prompt: Look up VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956 and show me the vehicle card.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_vehicle_specs first, then render_vehicle_card with the structured specs. The data tool does not mount UI.

negative.description: Do not trigger for mechanical repair instructions that do not require vehicle-data lookup.
negative.prompt: How do I replace brake pads on a bicycle?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to supported vehicle-data workflows.

negative.description: Do not trigger for vehicle purchasing transactions.
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest used SUV near me and arrange financing.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it cannot purchase vehicles, contact sellers, or arrange financing.

negative.description: Do not trigger for navigation or live traffic requests.
negative.prompt: Find the fastest driving route to the airport with current traffic.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because routing and live traffic are outside its supported workflows.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or take payment. It looks up vehicle data for an existing CarsXE account.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.0 packages CarsXE for the OpenAI Plugins directory and uses OAuth dynamic client registration so reviewers can sign in. Version 1.0.0 was rejected because reviewers could not complete OAuth sign-in.
